decisions.selection: Use 0BSD for software and executable code artifacts; use CC0-1.0 for specifications, documentation, metadata, diagrams, and artwork; accept contributions under matching outbound terms without a CLA; assign normative, errata, security, release, checksum, and publication authority to the project owner controlling the canonical tree; require SHA-256 release records while making detached cryptographic signatures optional; provide best-effort support for the declared Windows x86-64 Hosted scope.
